The Character Infobox is to be used at the top of non-Pokémon character pages; Pokémon character pages should use {{template|AnimePokémonInfobox}} instead. The full infobox is split into five templates starting with the main {{template|Character Infobox}}. The other four templates should be used immediately after the main template, when applicable, and |} must be put after the last template. ==How to use== ===Main template=== {| width="75%" class="roundy" style="margin:auto; border: 2px solid #{{yellow color dark}}; background: #{{yellow color}}" ! class="roundytl" style="background: #{{yellow color}}" | Parameter ! style="background: #{{yellow color}}" | Input ! class="roundytr" style="background:#{{yellow color}}" | When to use |- style="background:#FFF" | color | Main color for the template | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | bordercolor | Color of the border around the template | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | corecolor | Color of the left-side column of cells (Age, Eye color, Hometown) and slogan cell. | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | name | Character's full English name, including official titles (eg. Use only if a character's trademarked name and their standard romanized name are different (eg. Use "None.png" if there isn't one. | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | size | Size of the image in pixels (eg. 200px) | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | caption | Description of the image. Use "N/A" if the character is artificial or non-human. | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | height | Character's officially sourced height in imperial measurements followed by metric measurements in parentheses. Light blue (games), green (anime)). Use "Unknown" if the character is never seen/described, their eyes are always covered, or their eyes are only seen in black and white media. | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | hair | Character's hair color in colored media or described in text. Note the media in parentheses if the color differs between media (eg. Blond (games), light brown (anime)). Note the former color in parentheses if it was different at a point in the past (eg. White, brown (formerly, anime)). Note any facial hair if it is a different color from their head hair; use "bald" if they are bald (eg. Bald, white moustache). Use "Unknown" if the character is never seen/described, their head is always covered, or their hair is only seen in black and white media. | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | hometown | Current area character lives. Note any former places the character lived in parentheses (eg. Littleroot Town (formerly Olivine City)). Note the media in parentheses if the area differs between media (eg. New Bark Town (games), Big Town (anime)). Use "Unnamed town" if the town is shown/mentioned but not named. Use "Unknown" if there is no indication where the character lives. | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | region | Current region character lives. Note any former regions the character lived in parentheses (eg. Hoenn (formerly Unova)). Note the media in parentheses if the region differs between media (eg. Hoenn (games), Kanto (anime)). Use "Unknown" if the hometown's region is unclear or if there is no indication where the character lives. | Always |- style="background:#FFF" | relatives | Relatives of character, including adoptions, in-laws, and step family. Mentioned relatives only. State the relationship to the character if the relative is named (eg. Professor Birch (father), unnamed mother). Note the media in parentheses if the relatives differ between media (eg. Unnamed mother, unnamed father (anime)). | Only when relatives are mentioned. Do not use otherwise. |} ===[[Template:Character Infobox/Game|Game]]=== Use this template for characters seen in video games. Put it right below the main template if the character is primarily known for their game appearances. Put it below the anime and/or manga template if the character's game appearances are less notable, such as [[Ash Ketchum]]. For character pages that are specific media counterparts, like [[Misty (anime)]], only use this template for games that specifically base the character's appearance on the counterpart. For example, [[Pokémon Puzzle League]] is based on the main anime series so would be listed in this template on Misty (anime). {| width="75%" class="roundy" style="margin:auto; border: 2px solid #{{yellow color dark}}; background: #{{yellow color}}" ! class="roundytl" style="background: #{{yellow color}}" | Parameter ! style="background: #{{yellow color}}" | Input ! class="roundytr" style="background:#{{yellow color}}" | When to use |- style="background:#FFF" | color | Color of the left-side column of cells (Generation, Games).
